cohort: A pair of dicephalus dibrachius dipus conjoined twins
finding: Anatomical analysis of a rare, well-preserved dicephalus dibrachius dipus conjoined twin specimen revealed major abnormalities in the cardiovascular, respiratory, and digestive systems, including a unique three-atria heart.
mod_finding: This study examined a rare case of dicephalus dibrachius dipus conjoined twins delivered via cesarean section and did not compare outcomes to other modes of delivery.
